## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich lasse mich davon inspirieren.** — [ikh LAH-suh mikh dah-FON in-shpi-REE-ren] — *I'm letting myself be inspired by it.*
2. **Das spricht mich an.** — [dahs shprikht mikh AHN] — *That appeals to me. / That resonates with me.*
3. **Ich bin ganz bei der Sache.** — [ikh bin gants by dehr ZAH-khuh] — *I'm fully focused on what I'm doing.*
